field_descriptions.appearance: Indicates an occurrence of a [[Claim]] in some [[CreativeWork]].
field_descriptions.claim_interpreter: For a [[Claim]] interpreted from [[MediaObject]] content, the [[interpretedAsClaim]] property can be used to indicate a claim contained, implied or refined from the content of a [[MediaObject]].
field_descriptions.first_appearance: Indicates the first known occurrence of a [[Claim]] in some [[CreativeWork]].
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
